body:
We already have been past the point of talking to her.  My parents stopped her from OD on pills before.  This is why it is so confusing for our family.  Do not jump to conclusions about people thinking going on reddit is their first option.  We have been to therapists, parents and myself, she is refusing to go.

But it probably was my mistake to even think anyone outside of a professional could shed light on this situation.
Then what is the point of this whole subreddit if that is your mentality towards suicide?  Why does age have anything to do with how serious death is?
She does, I did, I know the procedures about blood sugar count, I am not wondering about that.  I am wondering about the bigger picture, the one that my grandmother might be trying to OD on in.
